In others, any kind of attraction outside the relationship might be seen as wrong. So, maybe the morality of it isn't black and white. Another angle to consider is the concept of consent. I also think about the idea of commitment. When you're in a relationship, especially a marriage, you make a commitment to your partner. Part of that commitment is being faithful and loyal. In terms of personal feelings, I think it's important to communicate with your partner about these things.
